fields.title: 📖 Fiqh according to ability
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“If I forbid you something, then avoid it. And if I command you something, then do of it what you are able.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **fiqh** joins **obedience** with **ability**. Prohibitions are avoided, and commands are fulfilled according to what is possible — without negligence and without exaggeration.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Iʿtiṣām bi’l-Kitāb wa’s-Sunnah, Bāb: al-Iqtidāʾ bi-Sunan Rasūl Allah ﷺ, Hadith Nr. 7288; Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Ḥajj, Hadith Nr. 1337.
